theme: A clear Saturday, with tomorrow's travel on the horizon.
greeting: The whole day is open, Dan — not a thing on the calendar. It's a prep day: the passport packet is the week's real clock, and there's a bag to pack before Sunday's flight to New York.

needsAttention.title: The passport packet is the week's one hard deadline
needsAttention.detail: Mike carries the documents through New York on Sunday and lands in Tampa Monday night, so Tuesday the 25th is the only real day to print the DS-11s and copies before the packet is due Wednesday the 26th and the appointment Friday the 28th.

needsAttention.title: The Sunday review with Mike is meant to clear the board
needsAttention.detail: The 15-minute call puts an owner and a date on everything and kills whatever has slipped three Sundays running — worth arriving knowing which board items are yours.

needsAttention.title: The destination edit work has been sitting since the 15th
needsAttention.detail: In Professional Projects, due August 15 and still open — the only overdue item that isn't a daily habit.
